changes.from: Maker's own DR01 page (deeprobotics.cn/en/index/humanoid.html, Chinese mirror /robot/index/humanoid.html) and a maker news item (Aug 2024) confirm DR01 as DEEP Robotics' first bipedal humanoid, but both URLs now 404 / redirect: the redesigned maker humanoid listing (opened) shows only DR02, so DR01 appears superseded/no longer listed. Maker-stated: walking speed >1.6 m/s, 18 cm steps, 25° slopes, J60 + J100 joints (from search excerpts of the maker page; page could not be opened). Height 170 cm, 80 kg, 12 DoF, 15 kg payload, 2 h runtime are aggregator-only (humanoid.guide etc.) - NOT filled. Status set to Research (research/embodied-AI platform, never priced).
